g.text: System evidence map: from rollout to eligible training data
Harbor + Daytona execution, SGLang proxy capture, ATIF facts, judgment, and gated data use | base ae103f70, 2026-10-05
Harbor 0.21 trial.py; opencode converter may return empty
Inspect bridge: routed calls; hosted-tool grants
(vLLM return_token_ids; SGLang unproven; borrow, not adopted)
rules: copy / tamper / stall / spend / loop
Docent: DQL selection, readings, human labels
Ari: calibrated judge → wider review (2% FPR ≠ precision)
METR: screens + manual review; audit non-flags
no confirmed exploit; no unreviewed suspicion
PROPOSED: SFT / RL train only on eligible
held-out families; hard negatives; low-FPR recall
GEPA: text vs evaluator + feedback; gate on controls
GEPA gskill / DSPy APIs: frozen splits; keep label scale
repair / probe proposals re-enter as new read-only evidence (ProposedAction requires_approval)
FOUNDATION — raw data, immutable: Harbor job dir + result.json is the reward source; no classifier, watch rule, or investigator rewrites it
Sources: docs/model-capture.md, docs/live-watch.md, docs/monitor-investigations.md (HAR-151), docs/task-quality.md, docs/observability.md, research/references/REFERENCE-MAP.md.
Solid borders = code-present on this base (red = immutable raw). Dashed purple = HAR-160 proposal; dashed gray = prior art. Capability map, not a coverage certificate.
